A LITTLE HELP

Good questions.

Talk to Menshood
How do I place an order?+

Choose a piece, select your size, and add it to your bag. The order review prepares one WhatsApp message with your selection. These pieces use the store’s supplied product photos and starter prices. The team will confirm stock, your preferred size, shipping, and payment on WhatsApp. An enquiry is confirmed only after the Menshood team accepts it.

How do I choose my size?+

Use the fit guide on each product to see how to measure. Select your preferred size, then confirm availability and garment measurements with the team. You can also ask Menshood for help on Instagram before ordering.

Where do you deliver?+

Shipping locations, charges, and dispatch times are awaiting confirmation. The team will confirm delivery availability for your PIN code before you pay.

What about returns and exchanges?+

The store’s return and exchange terms are being finalised. Confirm eligibility, conditions, and any return charges with the team before making a purchase.
